mapper.update: UPDATE gold_sql_executions SET performance_score = ( SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(j.performance_score * j.duration) / NULLIF(SUM(j.duration), 0), 0) AS DOUBLE) FROM gold_jobs j WHERE j.app_id = gold_sql_executions.app_id AND j.sql_execution_id = gold_sql_executions.execution_id ) WHERE app_id = #{appId}
